left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Able to provide written informed consent in English
-  Willing to have height  [OR] and weight measured and provide demographic information (e

age, race, sex)
  -  Experience heartburn symptoms at least 2 days a week during the past 3 months
-  Use OTC product(s), supplements, [OR]  or dietary manipulation to relieve heartburn symptoms in the last 3 months

right.raw_text: -  Willing to take the study soy supplement before resorting to OTC product(s) to control heartburn symptoms

left.raw_text: -  Willing to complete questionnaires, [OR]  records, [OR]  and diaries associated with the study and to complete all clinical visits
-  Willing to provide information about dietary intake; 3-day online 24-hr recalls during baseline, intervention, [AND]  and washout

right.raw_text: -  Willing and able to provide a valid social security for study payment purposes

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Do not meet the above criteria

right.raw_text:
-  Soy allergy
  -  Severe heartburn problem (cannot be ignored and often limits your concentration on daily activities) during the last week
  -  Diagnosed  [OR] or currently being treated for any gastrointestinal diseases including GERD, [OR]  gastric ulcers, [OR]  Crohn's, [OR]  celiac, [OR]  ulcerative colitis, etc

left.raw_text: -  Self-disclosed as pregnant  [OR] or breast-feeding  [OR] or planning on becoming pregnant during the study duration

right.raw_text: -  Currently participating in another clinical study
